QuestInfo.name: Free-for-all Professional
QuestInfo.0: Rosette told you that there is a Battle Mode challenge mission. Go and challenge yourself!
QuestInfo.1: Rosette, the Battle Square guide, told you that if you score 1000 points in one day in Free-for-all mode, she will give you a reward. Give it a try!\n\n#rTip! You must achieve a score of 1000 in one day in Free-for-all mode. If one day passes, your quest progress will reset.
QuestInfo.2: You have achieved a score of 1000 in Free-for-all mode and received a reward.

0.0: Hello, #h0#! I am Rosette, the Battle Square guide. Right now, I am handing out gifts to those who complete challenges.
0.1: This mission is to score 500 points in Free-for-all mode throughout the day! How does that sound? It's not that hard, is it?

yes.0: Okay, score 1000 points throughout the day! And remember, you gotta do it in one day! Otherwise, you lose your progress. Now, get out there and fight like you mean it!

no.0: It's not really a difficult mission... You can do it, can't you?

1.0: See? Piece of cake, right? 'Course it was. Here's your gift, just like I said.

yes.0: Hey, it's the master of Free-for-all mode! There are other missions available, you know, so step up to the challenge!

default.0: The mission is to score 1000 points in Free-for-all mode. I know you're not done yet, so hurry up!
